decisions.title: 새 관측 후보와 기존 확정 상태를 분리하고 적용 때만 합친다
observed: preservePartialCandidate concatenates accepted into new candidate by evidenceId/region; another photo cannot match that key.
linkComponents expects candidate IDs not already present in target and uses explicit linkOrigin for idempotence.
accept endpoint replaces same-field accepted; setAnswer also removes same-field candidates. Removing merge alone would therefore lose unseen state on direct acceptance.

Sol2: server/engine.ts:setAnswer (only local partial candidate application boundary as needed)

contract: commitAnalysisTask stores only fresh request observations. Remove preservePartialCandidate from commit and its source/ID remapping. Never copy accepted objects/old receipts into a new observation candidate. Original provider response and ObservationReceipt.result remain unchanged.

Keep accepted assertions intact while a scan completes and while user reviews. New candidate UUIDs are observation identities, never cross-photo physical identities. Same colour/value/region or the same printed card is insufficient to match existing objects.

Typed/Splendor: use existing ComponentLinkDialog/linkComponents to explicitly add selected observed pieces to a chosen destination; preserve unrelated accepted pieces and their user corrections. Repeated same assertionId+pieceId uses existing linkOrigin idempotence. Across a new photo, user selects truly additional pieces; do not automatically replace a supposed same physical piece. Correct an existing item in its existing editor when that is intended.
Catan: LocalCatanReview builds a separate draft from accepted board plus fresh observations; R2 controls safe geometry. Existing candidate receipt is not rewritten to look like this draft.

Rummikub native has no generic link API. Smallest UI addition is one explicit “기존 판과 함께 정정” action preparing a draft from accepted groups/order/IDs/loose plus this fresh candidate as separate loose tiles. Keep groups and edits unchanged; no automatic sequence matching or group creation. This deliberately adds observation candidates for user correction, not an assertion they are new physical tiles. Existing move/delete/undo supports clearing repeats before explicit final save.

For local partial candidates with existing accepted state, direct whole-value accept/top-save must not silently replace accepted. Route to existing link/review action; guard the same backend accept case. A local Rummikub candidate-only dirty draft also cannot bypass this through answers; prepare the baseline-inclusive review before enabling its save path. An empty baseline can accept a valid first partial record normally.

Final reviewed native scene is an explicit edited snapshot, so intentional manual removal is allowed; do not globally union old objects back in server setAnswer. Pin/recheck baseline assertion/revision before applying (existing CAS pattern), preserve original receipts for included source objects. Never silently rebase a dirty draft.

Unselected typed candidates remain available through existing unlinkedComponentPieces. Native review includes unresolved fresh observations as loose/unplaced until user removes or fixes them; do not lose them merely because geometry failed. If a native implementation offers subset apply rather than whole review, it must also retain residual candidate projections; immutable raw receipt alone is not a pending-item UI.
regressions: Accepted manually corrected old object A + different-photo fresh B: commit candidate contains only B, accepted A unchanged; explicit selected link adds B once and repeat is idempotent.
Same original ID carried from accepted must never be inserted into fresh candidate to trip target duplicate-ID conflict; source/evidence links remain correct.

Rummikub old ordered group + loose/manual edits survive rescan, review, save/reopen; fresh duplicates remain distinct until user removes them. Candidate-only accept and automatic photo preparation cannot erase old tiles.
Dirty or stale accepted baseline blocks that save without discarding draft; first scan into empty baseline remains usable.

decisions.title: 기하 후보는 항목별·순서 독립적으로 처리한다
observed: catanReviewScene loops over moveSceneComponent and throws on first rejection.
moveSceneComponent rejects unplaced quantity null and occupied destination; mergeBoardObservation can replace an existing same-layer slot when incoming is placed.

Sol2: shared/boardRecording.ts / shared/sceneMoves.ts only if a narrow helper is needed; preserve manual move/swap semantics

contract: Return review result {scene, placedRefs, unresolved:[{observationRef,reason}]} instead of throwing for a per-object placement rejection. Continue independent items; actual invalid source/frame/version or stale baseline remains hard failure.

Before moving anything, group proposed destinations by canonical slot plus exclusiveLayer; buildings share layer, terrain/number/robber coexist. Multiple distinct incoming observations competing for the same exclusive slot: defer ALL contenders; no first-wins loop-order result. Conflicting multiple destinations for one observation are also deferred.

Accepted occupied same-layer target is unresolved for this automatic review step, even if incoming is unique. Do not let mergeBoardObservation overwrite a manually corrected accepted item merely because geometry points there. The user can choose a manual correction/replacement using existing editor; the automatic helper does not swap or delete old state.

For this geometry batch only, quantity must already be exactly1 to place a loose object. null/0/>1 remains unchanged and unplaced with a reason; do not set1, split bundles, or infer a count to satisfy move validation. Existing manual split/move remains unchanged.

Use a separate incoming working copy; apply each unambiguous free-slot proposal through existing move semantics, keep any rejection unplaced, then combine with baseline without overwriting occupied layers. Original candidate and its receipt are unchanged. Stable ref/ID mapping must survive review/save.

Normal partial result is saveable: show a short count such as “배치 3개 · 위치 확인 2개”, keep unresolved visible and editable. All-unresolved still permits manual review/save. Remove the broad placementFailure gate for these ordinary per-item issues; retain dirty/stale/source checks and do not recompute over manual corrections.
regressions: Three independent free-slot items plus one quantity-null item: valid three place, null item stays unplaced, no exception for whole batch.
Two incoming objects claim same exclusive slot in either iteration order: both unresolved; a third independent target still places. Terrain+number on same hex do not conflict.
An accepted manually corrected number occupying target stays unchanged, new observation stays unplaced; explicit manual action still supports existing swap/correction.
Return result, undo and save/reopen preserve all unresolved objects and receipts; wrong/stale frame does not get treated as a harmless unknown.

decisions.title: 스플렌더 종류·단계는 관측대로 유지하고 의미 충돌만 보류한다
observed: Generated development permits visible kind=development|deck and level=1|2|3 independent of faceOnly.
Assembler ignores observed kind and chooses from face; unknown face yields null kind then observed level causes downstream strict readout throw.
Current Splendor validator ties level to kind although componentId already identifies card family.

Sol1: src/SplendorEditor.tsx / src/SplendorReadout.tsx only if needed to keep unknown-kind card level visible/editable; no redesign

contract: Honor explicit observed kind when allowed by componentId and not in conflict with observed face. Missing kind may use existing unambiguous face-to-front/back readout fallback; unknown face must not force a kind. No stack count is inferred from back-face display kind.

When componentId=development and kind is null, a valid independently observed level1/2/3 may remain level: allow that exact combination in validateSplendorObservation. The type already permits null kind; no new global schema/domain. Level never implies kind, front face, owner or purchase state. Other component families still reject a non-null level.

If explicit kind and known face conflict in current front-card/back-deck semantics, mark effective kind unresolved; keep valid family-level information, defer kind-dependent incompatible values. Do not silently prefer face or explicit kind as truth. User chooses kind in existing editor.

Distinguish valid-but-unrepresentable cross-field combinations from malformed data. Build a separate projected Splendor readout, retaining only compatible observed properties. Deferred attributes become null in the projected readout, with ref+attribute+reason in existing result warnings/summary; original values remain unchanged in ObservationReceipt.result. Do not mutate raw or claim the whole item was read correctly.

Unsupported combinations in one otherwise allowed observation must not discard independent valid objects in the same response. Handle these known semantic cases explicitly; do not catch every validation error and return success. Preserve the unresolved object/region for correction when representable.

Keep envelope/source/owner/definition/panel checks, property allowlist, types/domains and front-only constraints strict. For example unknown-face observed front-only cost/points remains invalid at that boundary; it is not this valid-level assembly bug. This decision does not authorize blanket salvage of malformed or out-of-scope provider input.

Known0 remains0, unknown remainsnull; missing cost colours are unknown rather than0. Keep kind selection and any restored deferred attribute as explicit user correction, never infer it from game rules.
regressions: development + face unknown + observed kind development + level2: keep kind development and level2; no inferred face.
development + face unknown + unknown kind + level2: kindnull/level2 survives validation, display/review and save/reopen.

Explicit deck conflicting with front-card face: unresolved kind, valid family level retained, incompatible attributes deferred with source ref; a separate valid chip/noble in the same response survives.
Noble with level, out-of-domain level4, front-only value on unknown/back face and wrong-owner source keep strict rejection; unknown/zero are never interchanged.

implementationOrder: Sol2 remove candidate premerge AND protect existing-state direct-accept path in the same patch; coordinate Sol1 native draft save change before enabling it.
Sol1 implement deterministic per-observation Catan review result without modifying model data or manual move semantics.
Sol2 implement Splendor projection and narrow independent-level rule; Sol1 verify existing unknown-kind display/correction path.
constraints: No new reconciliation engine, cross-photo identity inference, new model call or D1/D2 file change.
No tests were executed in this decision task. Listed regression cases are implementer acceptance instructions, not passing evidence.
Ordinary reversible choices resolved; no additional product approval needed.
